objective: Maximize validated safe net-profit precision at disclosed recommendation coverage, penalizing dangerous-upside and downside paths; no zero-loss guarantee
discussion_method: SmartGoal independent A/B/C proposals, cross-critique, D engineering integration

runner.reuse: design patterns only from local mylib paper_harness and HarnessBank; no upstream runtime invoked
runner.state_store: SQLite trial registry plus append-only events and atomic artifact manifests

write_scope.dirty_worktree_policy: capture relevant source files and patch hashes; preserve unrelated user edits; no implicit stash/reset/commit
write_scope.prediction_history: append-only; corrections create revision records without replacing original predictions

safe_profit_20d_research.role: new research hypothesis; not a silent replacement for opportunity_v3
safe_profit_20d_research.entry: market-calendar D+1 open reference, separate fill status
safe_profit_20d_research.horizon: market-calendar D+20; suspension does not extend forecast horizon
safe_profit_20d_research.primary_down_event: economic holding value below entry economic cost by more than 5% anywhere in the full window
safe_profit_20d_research.unfilled: keep recommendation record; do not assign a realized success label or postpone entry using hindsight
safe_profit_20d_research.unresolved_exit: retain pending status and bounds; extend actual position risk until legal exit
safe_profit_20d_research.ambiguous_ohlc: retain ex-ante candidate; report bounds and conservative execution; do not filter using future path
safe_profit_20d_research.availability: actual label_available_at, including data latency and unresolved outcomes

execution_book_v4.role: executable profit, episodes and portfolio ledger
execution_book_v4.primary_exit: fixed horizon; alternative stops/profit taking are separate trials
execution_book_v4.rules: exchange/board/status/effective-date table verified against official sources during implementation
execution_book_v4.costs: frozen before experiments; explicit units, minimums, slippage and stress cases
execution_book_v4.duplicate_recommendations: log signal, no automatic new position while already held
market_slices: BJ separate later configuration and evaluation

selection.weight_constraint: mu > lambda > nu >= 0; finite inner-development candidates only
selection.joint_probability: direct joint head or P(up)*P(down|up); never assume marginal independence
selection.policy_fit_segment: selection-policy segment only; strict chronological cross-fitting if necessary

validation.purge: label_available_at precedes next segment prediction time
validation.evaluation_universe: same complete ex-ante stock/date universe for all candidates; any subset is fixed and shared
validation.other_exposed_dates: inventory into exposure ledger; absence from this window does not make a date unseen
validation.sealed_start: first valid prediction after final model/policy freeze; not a fixed August date
validation.sealed_updates: only preregistered mature-label algorithm, no manual retuning
validation.sealed_feedback_access: only restricted evaluator and manifest-allowlisted frozen online updater may read matured sealed records; human research and tuning components cannot
validation.sealed_model_weights: static champion immutable; online champion updates only under frozen algorithm/window/rate/frequency policy with a snapshot per update
validation.gatekeeping: formal later-gate claims only after prior gate passes; otherwise descriptive or a separate new sealed protocol; never any-gate-wins
validation.feedback_delay: default use complete matured labels; early negative feedback requires a separate survival/delayed-feedback trial
validation.rare_event_boundary: no zero-width bootstrap risk guarantee; if defensible bound is unavailable return INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
validation.constant_baseline: matured historical frequency; test-frequency constant is diagnostic oracle only
validation.conformal_claim_boundary: coverage does not imply selected-stock conditional safety or zero loss

G1.rule: non-dominated risk/return/coverage frontier against simple and legacy baselines

G2.rule: consistent fold/seed direction and robustness; no advantage solely from optimistic fills, data filtering, or isolated regime

budget_proposal.nontrainable_controls: record trials but consume no actual fit; 72 is an upper bound
budget_proposal.runtime_limits: bind from H00 pilot before training; account CPU/GPU/memory/walltime; no unbounded search
budget_proposal.trial_definition: every selectable model, feature set, label variant, calibration, weight, threshold, N, exit policy and universe configuration is registered

stages.title: Snapshot and freeze research protocol
instructions: Inventory committed and uncommitted research sources without altering user changes
Record data exposure history, resource pilot and proposed budget
Implement minimal plan/manifest validation and durable run registry
Freeze task definitions, metrics and candidate accounting before model selection
acceptance: source recoverable including untracked S20-v3 files

stages.title: Audit calendar, price, corporate actions and point-in-time universe
instructions: Verify availability timestamps, market calendar and historical stock status
Quantify price discontinuities and stock-session versus market-session differences
Audit delisted/ST coverage and market rule data
Freeze an auditable universe; disclose exclusions and unavailable fields
acceptance: no unexplained future features or silent current-metadata substitution
stages.failure_action: block dependent formal training; continue only isolated diagnostics

stages.title: Dual label tracks and causal execution foundation
instructions: Implement compatibility opportunity and new safe-profit research contracts separately
Use market calendar D+1/D+20 and actual label availability
Keep ambiguous/unfilled/unresolved recommendations in the ex-ante ledger
Build fixed-horizon execution with date-effective board rules and cash ledger
acceptance: no final-day pct_chg used as known-at-open input

stages.title: Reproduce and establish matched baselines
instructions: Reproduce original-label metrics with source/version attribution
Recompute legacy algorithms and simple risk baselines on each new label track
Create chronological fit/tune/calibration/selection/test manifests
Enforce OOF anchors and identical evaluation universes
acceptance: no direct 50-percent-universe versus full-universe TopN comparison

stages.title: Bounded anchor/joint/conditional competition
instructions: Register every configuration before its evaluation
Run within the model-fit budget and shared folds
Save all seeds/failures/OOF predictions
Retain at most three non-dominated candidates including simple controls
acceptance: scientific failures recorded as NO_GAIN not retried with hidden new parameters
stages.failure_action: NO_GAIN is valid completion; do not invent a promotable winner

stages.title: Delayed calibration and selective recommendations
instructions: Compare raw/expanding/rolling or decay within calibration budget
Use complete mature feedback unless a separate delayed-event model is registered
Fit finite selection policies in their own chronological segment
Audit selected-subset calibration and risk/coverage with nullable empty-selection metrics
acceptance: no marginal-independence product for joint events
stages.failure_action: retain rank-only diagnosis or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; no confidence claim

stages.title: Conditional increments and guarded advanced algorithms
instructions: Test factor-group increments controlling ATR/liquidity/market state
Use tail/hazard methods only against adequate simple baselines
Activate expensive families only with documented residual error and budget
Any new model must regenerate its own chronological calibration/selection pipeline
acceptance: document skipped families; not all catalog routes are mandatory
stages.failure_action: reject costly branches without evidence; preserve simpler candidate

stages.title: Locked development evaluation and execution stress
instructions: Compare shortlisted pipelines at fixed and matched coverage
Stress costs/gaps/liquidity/unfilled orders/held-stock repeats
Separate signal, episode and portfolio results
Compute paired block and episode sensitivity intervals
acceptance: no hidden leverage or extra cash
no relabeling known development data as unseen
stages.failure_action: TRADEOFF, NO_GAIN or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; no forced promotion

stages.title: Freeze champion and prospective evaluation policy
instructions: Select at most one champion plus frozen baselines without prospective labels
Bind model/calibration-update/selection/execution hashes
Set review times, coverage and power requirements
Initialize holdout access isolation and ledger
acceptance: no pending human policy decisions silently assumed
stages.failure_action: complete research negative report if no eligible champion

stages.title: Collect genuinely future predictions and delayed outcomes
instructions: Start with first valid decision after champion freeze
Append predictions before outcomes and never backfill as prospective evidence
Apply only frozen mature-label update algorithm
Track fill failure, unresolved exit and actual portfolio exposure
acceptance: operations checks without premature performance peeking
stages.failure_action: WAITING_MATURITY for expected delay; suspend on validity incident with preserved evidence

stages.title: One-time review and scientific decision
instructions: Open at preregistered review only with sufficient mature blocks/episodes
Evaluate G3 relative improvement and separately G4/G5 challenge claims
Report all failures, unresolved records and coverage
Publish internal evidence report; do not modify production automatically
acceptance: no threshold relaxation reusing the same holdout
production change requires a separate task
stages.failure_action: REJECTED or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE is a valid final result
